updates.text: Apex Drone X1 logged 60 test flight hours this year.

policies.text: An equipment model is granted commercial deployment status for heavy-duty uses if it fulfills foundational production safety norms and carries a maximum payload weight capacity of at least 20 kg.

Authorization for the EU Commercial Fleet Listing is conferred when a candidate has commercial deployment status for heavy-duty uses and holds third-party liability insurance coverage of at least $3,000,000 in a year.
An apparatus satisfies all-weather submersion standards provided that it maintains an IP68 ingress protection rating.
An industrial chiller obtains Green Ventilation Certification if it records an annual seasonal performance ratio of at least 15 and maintains an operational noise level under 50 dB.
An industrial battery system qualifies for Grid Reserve Status when its nominal storage capacity exceeds 500 kWh.
A device meets foundational production safety norms when it completes a minimum of 100 test flight hours per year while holding an ISO 9001 quality certificate.
Designation under the High-Output Energy Tier is awarded to panels providing a peak power output of 400 W or greater.
